==Description==
The '''Solar Servant''' was one of the bosses of the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a high amount of health and a slow speed. It had one ability, where the '''Solar Servant''' smashed its axe at nearby towers, causing three explosions and stunning towers that were caught in its radius.

==Appearance==
The '''Solar Servant''' had neon orange skin. Its legs and torso were purple. It had a grey mask on its face and two neon orange horns. It wore purple shoulder-pads on its arms and a chestplate. It had a sun shaped object behind it. It wielded a solar axe.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]] are recommended to defeat this enemy.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can help boost these towers.
*Because of its freeze and poison immunities, the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot slow this down.
**As it has [[Energy Immunity]], the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it. Additionally, due to its large size, it can also only slow this down for a short amount of time.
*Be aware that the [[enemies]] that spawn before the '''Solar Servant''' have relatively high health, allowing it to walk further before getting damaged.
**Additionally, the '''Solar Servant''' will spawn one more time on wave 16 with the [[Lunar Servant]] and [[The Umbra]], making it even more dangerous.
**You can set some high DPS towers' targeting to ''Strongest'' to deal with the '''Solar Servant''' early.
***When wave 16 starts, they will target [[The Umbra]] instead of the '''Solar Servant.'''
